ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface with a high contrast ratio (>10:1) against the high-intensity (white/grey) water background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity (white) clusters are mapped as small circular spots on the lower-middle ventral surface, with a significant contiguous white mottle at the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a deep bounding-box depth and a sharp interior vertex angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with particularly high-amplitude jaggedness on the right lobe's distal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a linear, upward-sloping diagonal trajectory; right lobe follows a convex curve transitioning into a blunt, irregular distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameters) scattered across the black ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and high-contrast white scarring/encrustation at the distal tip of the right lobe, suggesting previous trauma or heavy colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical trailing edge serration pattern, where the right lobe exhibits significantly more irregular topography than the left.
